author: Forbes
description:
Daphne Koller Co-Founder, Coursera; Founder & CEO, Insitro, shares her remarkable journey from early academic prodigy to Silicon Valley trailblazer. Koller discusses her pivotal decision to pause her Stanford career to co-found Coursera, driven by a moral imperative to democratize global education. Now focusing on the intersection of machine learning and life sciences, she explains how her current work is leveraging artificial intelligence and massive biological datasets to revolutionize drug discovery and tackle devastating diseases like ALS.
